description: This file contains functions and classes for managing model and optimizer state dictionaries in PyTorch, supporting distributed training scenarios with FSDP, DDP, and tensor parallelism. It includes utilities for getting, setting, flattening, unflattening, and patching state_dict methods, with detailed options for sharding, offloading, and broadcasting.

classes.name: StateDictOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for how to get/set state dictionaries, including full sharding, offloading, and broadcasting options.

classes.name: _StateDictInfo
classes.description: Extended state dictionary options with additional mappings and context management for FSDP modules.

methods.name: _get_fqns
methods.description: Converts parameter names to fully qualified names (FQNs), handling DDP, FSDP, and compiler modules.

methods.name: _iterate_valid_model_state
methods.description: Recursively yields valid parameter and buffer names and objects from a model.

methods.name: _verify_options
methods.description: Verifies model, optimizers, and options, and constructs internal state info for get/set operations.

methods.name: _verify_state_dict
methods.description: Checks validity of provided state_dicts against model and optimizer configurations.

methods.name: _state_dict_fn
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate get/set method for a model or optimizer, considering patched versions.

methods.name: _maybe_full_or_cpu_state_dict
methods.description: Gathers or offloads state_dict based on options, supporting full or CPU offload modes.

methods.name: _get_model_state_dict
methods.description: Extracts the model's state_dict, handling FSDP, DDP, and submodule prefix options.

methods.name: _load_model_state_dict
methods.description: Loads a state_dict into a model, handling broadcasting, device placement, and strictness.

methods.name: _init_optim_state
methods.description: Initializes optimizer state by performing a zero-gradient step if uninitialized.

methods.name: _flatten_optim_state_dict
methods.description: Flattens nested optimizer state dicts into a dot-separated key structure for resharding.

methods.name: _unflatten_optim_state_dict
methods.description: Reconstructs nested optimizer state dicts from flattened keys.

methods.name: _get_optim_state_dict
methods.description: Extracts optimizer states, supporting FSDP, flattening, and device management.

methods.name: _split_optim_state_dict
methods.description: Extracts optimizer state for a specific optimizer from a combined state dict.

methods.name: _load_optim_state_dict
methods.description: Loads optimizer state into optimizers, handling FSDP, flattening, and device placement.

methods.name: get_model_state_dict
methods.description: Public API to retrieve the model's state_dict with options for submodules and sharding.

methods.name: get_optimizer_state_dict
methods.description: Public API to retrieve combined optimizer states with options.

methods.name: get_state_dict
methods.description: Returns both model and optimizer state dicts, supporting distributed and parallel training.

methods.name: set_model_state_dict
methods.description: Loads a state_dict into a model, with validation and strictness options.

methods.name: set_optimizer_state_dict
methods.description: Loads optimizer state into optimizers, supporting FSDP and device management.

methods.name: set_state_dict
methods.description: Loads both model and optimizer state dicts into the respective objects.

methods.name: _patch_model_state_dict
methods.description: Patches model's state_dict and load_state_dict methods to use custom get/set functions.

methods.name: _patch_optimizer_state_dict
methods.description: Patches optimizer's state_dict and load_state_dict methods to use custom functions.
